name: Aptener Release
description: One-click verified board release: prefab-gate, fab outputs, iBOM, test points. KiCad 10 (IPC API).
description_full:
KiCad 10.0 IPC API plugin that adds an Aptener Release button to the PCB editor toolbar. It checks the committed board with prefab-gate on a temporary copy (your files are never written), then creates Manufacturing/<board>_<rev>_<DDMMYY>/ beside the board (1_Fabrication, 2_Assembly, 3_Test, 4_Documentation): Gerber + drill zip, PCB stackup, position file, component data, test points, BOM, iBOM, schematic and assembly PDFs, STEP, top/bottom renders and a manifest, plus a zip of it all, and tags the git commit. It refuses boards with uncommitted changes or an empty rev.

Requires Preferences → Plugins → Enable KiCad API, git on PATH and the Interactive HTML BOM plugin from this Plugin and Content Manager. Test points are pads with Fabrication property "Test point pad".
